confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from five web searches. The summaries were mostly user-submitted venue listings (Atly) and cost-of-living aggregators (MyLifeElsewhere, Nomad.watch, a July 2023 TravelTables figure), not a dated Samui price index. I did not open the pages myself. Evidence in baht: cappuccino about 45-90, beer about 70-100, budget-bar cocktails about 99 (100-200 at pricier venues), one wine glass at 150, local meals about 100-115, and a mid-range three-course meal for two at about $26 in 2023. I adjusted upward for tourist-zone venues and price drift, and converted at an assumed 33 THB/USD. Cocktail and wine rely mainly on their usual relationship to beer (about 1.9x and 2x), so they are the least certain drink anchors. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge for a July 2026 window, with no accommodation searches or listing inspection, and are the weakest. The FX rate comes from the RBA search result summary, not a page I opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparator city was searched. Prices are judged from general knowledge of Thai tourist islands such as Phuket and Koh Phangan. Samui's tourist zones (Chaweng, Bophut, Lamai) price similar to or slightly below Phuket and above mainland cities such as Chiang Mai. Cheaper local eateries and bars pull the typical meal and beer figures down.
